trek.definition:
n. a journey by ox wagon (especially an organized migration by a group of settlers)
n. any long and difficult trip
v. journey on foot, especially in the mountains
v. make a long and difficult journey
trek.translation:
vi. 牛拉货车, 艰苦跋涉
n. 牛车旅行, 艰苦跋涉

trekk.translation: v. 缓慢艰辛地旅行;移居;离开

trekked.definition:
v journey on foot, especially in the mountains
v make a long and difficult journey
trekked.translation: v. 艰苦跋涉, 徒步旅行( trek的过去式和过去分词 ); （尤指在山中）远足, 徒步旅行, 游山玩水

trekker.definition: n. a traveler who makes a long arduous journey (as hiking through mountainous country)

trekkers.definition:
plural of trekker
n. a traveler who makes a long arduous journey (as hiking through mountainous country)

trekkie.translation: n. （美）太空旅行迷；《星球旅行》迷

trekking.definition:
v journey on foot, especially in the mountains
v make a long and difficult journey
trekking.translation: v. 艰苦跋涉, 徒步旅行( trek的现在分词 ); （尤指在山中）远足, 徒步旅行, 游山玩水

treks.definition:
n a journey by ox wagon (especially an organized migration by a group of settlers)
n any long and difficult trip
v journey on foot, especially in the mountains
v make a long and difficult journey
treks.translation:
n. 远距离行走 ( trek的名词复数 ); 长途跋涉, 艰难的旅程（尤指在山区）
v. 艰苦跋涉, 徒步旅行( trek的第三人称单数 ); （尤指在山中）远足, 徒步旅行, 游山玩水
